**What this changes, and why**

**How it was tested**

- [ ] `ruff format`, `ruff check`, `pyright` and `pytest` are clean in every Python project touched
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm build` are clean, if `web/` or `kiosk/client` changed
- [ ] A fixed bug has a test that failed before the fix
- [ ] A model change has a migration, read after it was generated
- [ ] Docs and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated
